implementation_sequence: 1. Obtain report owner acknowledgement of this registry’s section-to-field group placement and reconcile the prose requirement notes; keep chart requirements blank until source specifies them.

2. For R01 only, verify exact current KIS quote portal response and complete issuer/security/venue identity plus date/receipt provenance; retain user-reported HTTP 200/field names as a separate evidence class.
3. Bind KR daily history and DART company/list/financial JSON fields to exact response paths and deterministic period/account concept maps; add fixtures only after provider schemas are cited.

4. Expand candidate endpoint response schemas per report dependency: market flows/news titles, then read-only account/ledger, ETF, futures, overseas assets, macro/SEC. Keep account scope/rights consent separate.

5. Add tests by layer: raw-schema fixtures, normalization/units/periods, provider error/pagination/rate-limit/timeout, rights gates, source-time correctness, report consumer binding, and synthetic-vs-live evidence provenance.
6. Only after the R01 fields are source-bound and tool implementation is stable, collect a newly authorized live sample and produce the local HTML report; no new call was made by this registry task.

No KIS or DART request was sent while building this registry.
The user-pasted OAuth/quote success is metadata-only evidence from user execution and does not prove that the current MCP host made the request or that a complete R01 can be published.
